 potential = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 6 } } }

}

custom_text_box = {
    name = "zhx_ad_row_baihe_5_status"
 potential = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 6 } } }

}

custom_button = {
    name = "zhx_ad_row_baihe_5_goto"
 potential = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_offset value = 6 } } }
 trigger = { zhx_ad_live_baihe = yes }
 effect = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 11 } clr_country_flag = zhx_ad_visible country_event = { id = zhx_ad.110 } } }
 tooltip = zhx_ad_goto_tt

}

custom_button = {
    name = "zhx_ad_ruins_button_baihe"
 potential = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 11 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 12 } } }
 trigger = { always = yes }
 effect = { every_province = { limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_baihe } custom_tooltip = zhx_ad_ruin_name } }
 tooltip = zhx_ad_ruins_tt

}

    name = "zhx_ad_ruins_count_baihe"

}

custom_button = {
    name = "zhx_ad_expel_baihe"
 potential = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 11 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_ad_selected value = 12 } } zhx_ad_live_baihe = yes event_target:zhx_ad_site_baihe = { owned_by = ROOT } }
 trigger = { zhx_ad_can_expel_baihe = yes }
 effect = { hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = zhx_ad.210 } } }
 tooltip = zhx_academy_issue_expulsion_tt

}
